description: The file implements the HomeScreen widget of a Flutter application, including layout and navigation elements for the Pomodoro Ladder app. It arranges the main components such as the game board, timer controls, streak/progress indicators, and the app drawer.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the application's home screen, managing layout and state.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: State class for HomeScreen, handling app lifecycle events and building the widget tree.

classes.name: _AppDrawer
classes.description: Widget representing the side navigation drawer with app options.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, adding observable for app lifecycle.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes observers to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: didChangeAppLifecycleState
methods.description: Handles app lifecycle changes to pause or background the Pomodoro timer.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the HomeScreen layout with Scaffold, AppBar, ListView, and widgets.

methods.name: buildColoredHeader
methods.description: Extension method for styling header containers with a gradient background.
